verdict.stance: Overweight / Sovereign-Equalized Caspian Energy Champion (Baa3/BBB-/BB Pos)
verdict.summary: 100% Azerbaijan state-owned national oil & gas champion equalized with the IG sovereign by Moody's (Baa3 Stable) and Fitch (BBB- Stable, SCP upgraded to bb). FY25 audited EBITDA jumped 26% YoY to AZN 10.9bn ($6.4bn) with AZN 8.72bn cash (+AZN 6.26bn deposits) nearly matching AZN 15.10bn gross debt, providing ~1.0x net leverage.

positives: 100% state ownership with sovereign rating equalization (Moody's Baa3 / Fitch BBB-) and ~12% state-guaranteed debt.
Strong FY25 EBITDA jump (+26% to AZN 10.9bn) and deep liquidity (AZN 8.72bn cash + AZN 6.26bn deposits vs AZN 15.10bn total debt).
Integrated European/Turkish downstream & midstream assets (STAR Refinery, Southern Gas Corridor).
negatives: Thin trading-inflated consolidated EBITDA margin (12.6% on AZN 86.3bn revenue due to SOCAR Trading).
Mature domestic ACG oil decline curve requiring sustained ~AZN 4bn/yr upstream and transition capex.
Hydrocarbon price sensitivity and sovereign fiscal extraction via taxes/dividends.

background.business_overview: Fully state-owned national oil, gas, refining, petrochemicals, and global energy trading company of Azerbaijan.
background.asset_perimeter: Domestic upstream (~7.1Mt oil, ~7.8bcm gas), Southern Gas Corridor, STAR Refinery & Petkim (Türkiye), SOCAR Trading (Switzerland).
background.ownership_governance: 100% Republic of Azerbaijan; EY-audited IFRS financials.
